test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: S₁ and S₂ can do a piece of work together in 18 days, S₂ and S₃ can do the same work together in 27 days, while S₃ and S₁ can do it together in 54 days. In how many days can all 3, working together, do 50% of the work?
solution:
**Given:**

S1 and S2 can do a piece of work together in 18 days, 

S2 and S3 can do the same work together in 27 days, 

while S3 and S1 can do it together in 54 days.

**Calculations:**

Let the time taken by S₁ be a , S₂ be b and S₃ be c.

Now, according to question,

(1)/(a) + (1)/(b) = (1)/(18)-------------------(1)

And, (1)/(b) + (1)/(c) = (1)/(27)-----------(2)

Also, (1)/(c) + (1)/(a) = (1)/(54)----------(3)

From equation (1),(2) and(3), we get:

(1)/(a)+ (1)/(b) + (1)/(c) = frac{frac{1} {18} + frac{1} {27} + frac{1} {54}}{2}= (1)/(18)

Now, if S₁, S₂ and S₃ together takes 18 days to complete the work

then, it will take 9 days to do the half work.

**Hence, The Required value is 9 days.**

Combined efficiency of 2(S₁ + S2 + S3) = 6 units/day 

⇒ (S1 + S2 + S3) = 3 units/day

Also, half of the work = 54/2 = 27 units

Time is taken them to complete half of work.

⇒ 27/3 = 9 days.
